meta.title: Improve image response performance
meta.body_summary: Tweak image response handling with Content-Length header, stricter typing, and safer hashing; add changelog entry.

perf_labels.notes: Small PHP image response tweak with content-length and type safety; merged immediately by maintainer without review or benchmark.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 354 changed lines (mostly from a merge bringing in unrelated master commits; core performance change is 27 lines in ImageResponse.php + 4 in CHANGELOG), this is a small absolute scale PR. It fits a maintainer-driven, no-fuss quick performance tweak with immediate self-merge.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or feedback captured.
review_details.performance_claim: Improve image response handling with content length, stricter typing, and safer hashing for better performance.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Simple PHP class tweak in a personal/maintained repo; no external review or evidence required; Codex contributed a small, self-contained change that was immediately merged by the repo owner.

maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression concerns raised or observed.

core_change_summary.description: In lib/Http/ImageResponse.php, added Content-Length header, stricter type declarations, and updated hashing for image responses. Accompanying CHANGELOG entry and merge from master introduced additional MusicController/MusicMapper/MusicService refactors unrelated to the immediate performance claim.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most line changes (296 of 354) come from merge bringing in unrelated master commits (MusicController refactor and new Mapper/Service files).
change_trajectory: Initial commit: add content-length, type hints, and adjust hashing in ImageResponse; update CHANGELOG.
